notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
